about.title: About HeartBox
about.tagline: A quiet place to write down what you feel.
about.missionBody: Mental health support should not be a luxury. HeartBox combines mood journaling, AI feedback, habit tracking, and peer support so taking care of yourself has the lowest possible barrier. We believe writing things down is the first step to understanding them.
about.howBody: Spend a minute or two each day writing how you feel. HeartBox tracks the trends, nudges you when you need rest, and uses machine learning to flag stress patterns. Everything is encrypted; you can export or delete it any time.
about.teamBody: HeartBox is built by independent developers — no outside investors, no pressure to monetize your data. The only goal is to make every user feel a little better than they did before opening the app.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The most-asked things before launch
faq.a.privacy: Yes. Notes and AI conversations are encrypted at rest, only you can read them, and we never sell or use them for ads.
faq.q.aiSafety: Is the AI feedback professional therapy?
faq.a.aiSafety: No. The AI is a support tool — it does not replace professional counseling. If you are in serious distress, please call a counselor or a crisis line (e.g. 988 in the US).
faq.q.data: Where is my data stored? Can I get it back?
faq.a.data: Data lives in encrypted Neon Postgres and Cloud Run (asia-east1). You can download a JSON or CSV copy any time via Settings → Your data.
faq.q.crisis: What happens if I write about self-harm?
faq.a.crisis: A banner with regional crisis hotlines (988 / 1925 / Befrienders…) appears at the top. We never block what you write or auto-report it — we just make sure help is one tap away.
faq.a.free: Yes — all features are free during launch. If paid plans arrive later we will tell you well in advance, and the free features you have today will stay free.
faq.q.delete: What happens when I delete my account?
faq.a.delete: Deletion is scheduled 30 days out. Until then you can cancel any time, or just sign back in to restore the account. After 30 days everything is permanently removed.
faq.a.languages: Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese, switchable from the top-right corner. More languages will come later.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: HeartBox collects your account information (username, email) and the journal content you enter. We do not collect your device location, contacts, or other personal data.
privacy.s2Body: All journal content is encrypted using AES-CBC + HMAC-SHA256 (Fernet) before storage. Even in the event of a data breach, third parties cannot read your journal entries.
privacy.s3Body: Your journal content is sent to HeartBox's self-hosted LLM inference server (TAIDE + LLaVA, running on Taiwan-resident GPU hardware) for sentiment analysis and feedback. The content is NOT sent to OpenAI or any other offshore AI service. Regarding model training: **by default, your data is NOT used for training**; it is used for HeartBox's internal AI model optimisation in anonymised form (user ID, name and other identifying fields removed) ONLY if you explicitly opt in during the consent flow. You can withdraw this consent at any time under Settings → Privacy. AI analysis results are for reference only and do not constitute professional medical or psychological advice.
privacy.s4Body: We use the following third-party services:
privacy.s4Item1: Self-hosted LLM inference server (TAIDE + LLaVA, Taiwan-resident) — AI sentiment analysis
privacy.s5Body: You have the right to export all your data (JSON format) at any time, and to permanently delete your account and all associated data. These features can be found in the Settings page.
privacy.s6Body: We use localStorage to store authentication tokens (JWT) and user preferences (theme, language). We do not use third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.s7Title: 7. Health Data (Android Health Connect / iOS HealthKit)
privacy.s7Intro: If you grant HeartBox access to Health Connect on Android (or HealthKit on iOS), we read the following health data types:
privacy.s7Purpose: How we use it: (1) tag exercise/sleep context on journal entries; (2) display in the health dashboard and weekly/monthly reports; (3) correlate with mood records. Health data is processed only within your account and is never used to train AI models.
privacy.s7Sharing: Sharing: HeartBox does not sell or share your health data with any third-party advertiser or data broker. Content sent to the self-hosted LLM inference server is limited to journal text and does not include raw health metric values, and is not retained beyond the inference call.
privacy.s7Retention: Retention and deletion: You may revoke Health Connect access in Android system settings (or HealthKit in iOS settings) at any time. You may also delete all health records and journal data stored under your HeartBox account via Settings → Delete Account.
terms.heading: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: HeartBox is a personal mood journal application that provides emotional tracking, AI sentiment analysis, data visualization, and counselor matching features.
terms.s2Body: The AI analysis features in this application are for reference only and do not constitute any form of medical diagnosis, psychotherapy, or professional counseling advice. If you are experiencing serious emotional distress or mental health issues, please seek help from a qualified professional.
terms.s3Item1: Do not use this service for any illegal activities
terms.s3Item2: Do not attempt to hack, decompile, or interfere with the service
terms.s4Body: You retain full ownership of all journal content you create. We will not use your content for any commercial purposes or share it with third parties (except for AI analysis, see Privacy Policy).
terms.s5Body: You may delete your account at any time. Once deleted, all associated data will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered.
terms.s6Body: We reserve the right to modify this service or these terms at any time. Significant changes will be communicated through in-app notifications.

prediction.title: Mood Prediction
prediction.subtitle: Forecast future trends based on your journal history
prediction.disclaimer: Predictions are for reference only — based on historical trend analysis, not professional medical advice.
prediction.insufficientData: Need at least 5 journal entries in the past 30 days to generate predictions. Keep journaling and the AI will spot trends.
prediction.warning.stress_spike_predicte: Based on your recent patterns, there's a {percent}% chance of a high-stress day in the next 3 days. Consider preventive self-care.
prediction.warning.mood_decline: Your mood has been declining over the past {days} days — a noticeable downward trend.
prediction.warning.stress_increase: Your stress levels are rising. Current trend suggests continued increase.
prediction.warning.high_stress: Your current stress level is high ({level}/10). This may impact your well-being.
prediction.warning.mood_low_declining: Your mood is low and continuing to decline. Please prioritize your mental health.
prediction.warning.mood_improving: Your mood is improving! Keep up the positive momentum.
prediction.warning.stress_decreasing: Your stress levels are decreasing. Well done managing your stressors!
prediction.rec.reach_out: List 3 people who've made you feel safe in the past 6 months. Reach out to one for a 30-min in-person chat this week — face-to-face beats messaging for reducing anxiety.
prediction.rec.joy_activities: Write down 5 things you did in the past 6 months that lifted your mood. Pick one to do today, however small (rewatch a favorite movie, cook a familiar dish).
prediction.rec.deep_breathing: Try box breathing: inhale 4s → hold 4s → exhale 4s → hold 4s, for 4 cycles. Drops cortisol (the stress hormone) noticeably within 4 minutes.
prediction.rec.review_commitments: Write down everything on your plate this week. Rate each 1–10 by importance. Anything ≤ 5 — delete or postpone today. Decision fatigue is a top stressor.
prediction.rec.rest_self_care: Block 30 minutes tonight for non-productive time. Notifications off, no social media, do one thing purely for enjoyment (book, bath, music).
prediction.rec.professional_help: If high stress has lasted >2 weeks, book a counselor. Many countries' national health services subsidize 4–8 sessions/year — check your local mental health authority.
prediction.rec.mental_health_pro: Book a licensed clinical or counseling psychologist. First session: spend 15–20 min describing your situation so the therapist can pick the right approach (CBT, ACT, mindfulness).
prediction.rec.talk_friends: Find one trusted person. Be explicit: "I want to talk, not get advice — I just need to be heard." Research shows validation calms emotions faster than solutions.
prediction.rec.reflect_habits: Look at the last 7 days of journal entries. Pick the 2 highest and 2 lowest. Note what you did, who you saw, what you ate, how you slept. Finding patterns is core CBT.
prediction.rec.continue_practices: Build a "self-care menu" from the past 30 days of things that lifted you. Save it in your notes app — when you're low, just pick one, no decision needed.
prediction.rec.maintain_strategies: Make an "emotional first-aid kit": 3 things you can do in <5 min to drop stress (walk, specific playlist, 10 deep breaths). Execute on autopilot when low.
prediction.rec.continue_journaling: Keep journaling daily, at least 100 words. Morning: today's small goal. Evening: emotion review. 21 days builds the habit.
prediction.rec.balanced_routine: Three simple rules: sleep 1 hour earlier, exercise 3×/week (30 min each), one face-to-face conversation daily. Hitting 2 of 3 noticeably stabilizes mood.
prediction.rec.mindful_warning_signs: Your warning-sign list might include: insomnia >3 days, big appetite shift, social withdrawal, can't focus 30 min. 2 signs = yellow flag, 3+ = book a professional.
prediction.tip.breathing_4_7_8: 4-7-8 breathing: inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s through mouth. 4 cycles. 8 weeks of practice lowers anxiety scores ~50%. Bonus: helps you fall asleep.
prediction.tip.physical_activity: 10 min brisk walk + sunlight = cheapest mood boost there is. 20 min exercise releases BDNF — antidepressant-like effects, no side effects. Or just climb 3 flights of stairs.
prediction.tip.consistent_sleep: Consistent wake time matters more than bedtime. Don't drift more than 1 hour on weekends. Sleep debt >2 hours impairs emotional judgment.
prediction.tip.hydration: 500ml water on waking, another glass before each meal. 2% dehydration drops focus and raises anxiety. Caffeine doesn't count. Pale yellow urine = on track.
prediction.tip.social_connection: 2 face-to-face interactions ≥30 min per week. Texting and social media don't count — research shows they often increase loneliness instead. Even a lunch with a coworker works.
prediction.tip.gratitude: Each night, write 3 specific things from that day (not "my family" — write "X helped me order lunch today"). 8 weeks raises baseline happiness ~25% (Emmons, 2003).

landing.title: HeartBox
landing.subtitle: Your private AI-powered mood journal with encryption and emotional insights.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need for Mental Wellness
landing.featureJournalDesc: Record daily moods with rich text, weather, and tags. AI analyzes your emotions automatically.
landing.featureAIDesc: Chat freely with your AI companion for emotional support, reflection, and guidance.
landing.featureAnalyticsDesc: Visualize mood trends, stress distribution, and correlations through interactive charts.
landing.featureBreatheDesc: Built-in breathing exercises and meditation timer to help you relax.
landing.featureCounselorDesc: Browse approved counselors, book sessions, and get professional support.
landing.featureAssessmentDesc: Standardized PHQ-9 and GAD-7 questionnaires to track mental well-being.
landing.pricingDesc: Start for free, upgrade when you're ready.
onboarding.welcomeDesc: Your private space to record feelings, track moods, and grow emotionally. Every entry is end-to-end encrypted — only you can read it.
onboarding.journalDesc: Write your first mood entry. AI automatically analyzes sentiment, calculates a stress index, and gives you warm reflective feedback.
onboarding.journalHint: The Journal page has an input form — write a few words to begin.
onboarding.aiDesc: When you're feeling low, chat freely with an empathetic AI. Conversations are encrypted and private; by default not used for training — only used in anonymised form if you explicitly opt in during the consent flow.
onboarding.aiHint: Open "AI Chat" from the navigation to start a conversation.
onboarding.dashboardDesc: Mood trends, stress radar, year-in-pixels, AI weekly reports — see your mental state at a glance.
onboarding.dashboardHint: Find "Weekly / Monthly Report" in the navigation for long-term trends.
onboarding.healthDesc: Connect Health Connect to auto-sync steps, heart rate, sleep — making AI insights more accurate.
onboarding.healthHint: Go to Settings → Health Data, tap "Connect" and follow the on-screen steps (mobile only).
onboarding.exploreDesc: Discover dashboards, breathing exercises, assessments, and more in the navigation.
onboarding.firstNoteHint: Write your first entry right here!

twofa.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twofa.description: Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. Once enabled, you'll need a verification code in addition to your password when signing in.
twofa.recommendedApps: Recommended: Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator
twofa.step1: 1. Download an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator)
twofa.step2: 2. Scan the QR code below with the app
twofa.step3: 3. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app
twofa.backupWarning: Save this secret key in a safe place. You can use it to recover access if you lose your phone.

health.connectFailedDetail: Connection failed. Open the Health Connect app → App permissions → HeartBox, verify all 5 permissions are enabled, then tap Connect again.
health.step2: Health Connect will open its permission page — turn on all 5 toggles: Steps, Heart rate, HRV, Active calories, Sleep.
health.step3: Tap "Allow" in the top-right to come back to HeartBox. The status dot turns green when connected.
